title: lifecycle-invariants.json A11 names MAX_CLOSEOUT_BOOTS, which dl8 deleted; the bundle needs a re-cut
body: The pinned lifecycle contract's A11 `today` site for cloud/factory/src/run-workflow.ts lists MAX_CLOSEOUT_BOOTS, a symbol dl8 deleted with the closeout pass. run-workflow.ts carries a deletion note that names the constant so internal/factory/lifecycle's Go conformance reader (strings-contains) stays green, but the cross-reference is now false: the note, not the rule, is what satisfies it. Re-cut the bundle (as was done for l6t's wave symbols) and drop both the A11 symbol and the interim note.
